newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai sees '97 net at 100 bln won.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai sees '97 net at 100 bln won.

text.p: Hyundai Group Industries Co, an affiliate of South Korea's Hyundai Group, forecast its net profit would rise to 100 billion won in calendar 1997 from 71.14 billion won a year earlier.
An official in Hyundai Electronics' financial division said sales would grow to four trillion won this year from 3.17 trillion a year earlier.
"Semiconductor prices showed signs of improving and we have seen brisk sales of telecommunications equipments," he said.
"As long as prices for 16-megabit DRAM (dynamic random access memory) chips remain stable at around $8-$9, our company is expected to post good margins," he said.

In 1998, when the company is likely to post break-even in the thin film transistor-liquid crystal display business, net profit in Hyundai Electronics would rise to 400 billion won on 6.5 trillion in sales.
